title: Breast-augmentation method uses your own fat in dissolving scaffolds | New Scientist
description: A new approach to breast augmentation injects fat from elsewhere in the body into dissolvable scaffolds shaped like bra cups, which may lead to a more natural look and fewer complications
author: Alice Klein

title: Three black holes discovered in a young galaxy for the first time | New Scientist
description: Three massive black holes have been found in a galaxy that existed during the earliest times of the universe
author: James Woodford

title: How to watch today's spectacular solar eclipse | New Scientist
description: A total solar eclipse is set to be visible across parts of Europe today, while a partial eclipse will sweep across about a quarter of the planet – here’s how to see it
author: Leah Crane

title: CRISPR-armed phages help treat severe superbug infection | New Scientist
description: Bacteria-killing phage viruses souped up with DNA-destroying CRISPR appear to have helped clear up a very serious infection caused by antibiotic-resistant E. coli
author: Michael Le Page

title: Heart surgery cured a man’s skin cancer – and gave him a bee allergy | New Scientist
description: Having surgery for a heart condition is thought to have triggered an immune response that put the patient into remission for his severe skin cancer, but also caused him to develop a serious allergy to bee stings
author: Carissa Wong

title: Rainbows can be made from sounds – and we've created the best ones yet | New Scientist
description: Two research teams have independently created devices within which sound waves could be separated by frequency, creating the most complete sound rainbows yet
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan
